definition_zh: 保密义务；机密性；保密；保密性
definition_en: the state of being kept secret, or the duty not to disclose private information
core_image: 一只手按在唇边，另一只手把文件护在胸前
scene: 律师事务所里，新来的助理把客户档案锁进柜子。The young lawyer accepted a strict duty of confidentiality before reviewing the files.
sceneCN: 这里 confidentiality 是「保密义务」（第 2 个义项：合同或法律上的保密义务）；句意：这位年轻律师在审阅文件之前承担了严格的保密义务。

senses.title: The state of being secret
senses.definition: the quality of information that is kept secret from others
senses.definitionCN: 信息被保密、不为他人所知的性质
senses.example: The confidentiality of the patient records is protected by law.
senses.exampleCN: 病人记录的机密性受法律保护。
senses.why: The Latin root fidere means to trust, and information given in trust is kept from public view.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根 fidere 意为「信任」，受托告知的信息自然不向公众公开。

senses.title: A duty not to disclose
senses.definition: a legal or contractual obligation to keep information secret
senses.definitionCN: 依法或依合同保守信息秘密的义务
senses.example: The adviser owes a duty of confidentiality to the client.
senses.exampleCN: 顾问对客户负有保密义务。
senses.why: Trust becomes a duty when the law or a contract turns confidence into an obligation.
senses.whyCN: 当法律或合同把「信任」变成义务时，保密就成为必须履行的责任。

senses.title: The practice of protecting information
senses.definition: the practice or system of limiting access to sensitive information
senses.definitionCN: 限制他人接触敏感信息的做法或制度
senses.example: Strict confidentiality governs the handling of medical data.
senses.exampleCN: 医疗数据的处理受到严格的保密制度约束。
senses.why: A secret can be kept only if access is controlled, so the abstract quality grows into a working practice.
senses.whyCN: 秘密只有在接触受到控制时才能保住，因此抽象的「机密性」长成了可操作的保密做法。

senses.title: A contractual promise of secrecy
senses.definition: a clause or promise in an agreement that restricts disclosure of information
senses.definitionCN: 协议中限制披露信息的条款或承诺
senses.example: The confidentiality clause survives the end of the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 保密条款在合同结束后仍然有效。
senses.why: The duty is often written into a clause, so the word also names the promise itself.
senses.whyCN: 保密义务常被写进条款，因此这个词也指条款中的那项承诺。

senses.title: Protection of private communications
senses.definition: the legal protection that keeps private conversations and messages from being revealed
senses.definitionCN: 使私人谈话与信息不被公开的法律保护
senses.example: The lawyer objected that the search violated confidentiality.
senses.exampleCN: 律师提出异议，称该搜查侵犯了通信秘密。
senses.why: Because trust covers what is spoken and written, the word extends to the privacy of communication.
senses.whyCN: 信任也覆盖说出口和写下来的内容，所以这个词延伸到通信的秘密。

intro.en: Confidentiality is built in English on confidential, which traces back through French or Latin to confidentia and confidere, to trust completely.
intro.cn: confidentiality 在英语中由 confidential 构成，后者经法语或拉丁语上溯至 confidentia 与 confidere（完全信任）。

items.en: Confidere joins con-, meaning fully, with fidere, to trust.
items.cn: confidere 由表示「完全」的 con- 与表示「信任」的 fidere 组合而成。

items.en: Confidentia names trust, confidence, or boldness.
items.cn: confidentia 表示信任、信心或胆量。

items.en: French confidentiel, kept in confidence, is generally thought to shape the English adjective.
items.cn: 一般认为，法语 confidentiel（受信任而保密的）塑造了这个英语形容词。

items.en: Confidential appears in English meaning entrusted with secrets.
items.cn: confidential 在英语中出现，意为「受托而知秘密的」。

items.en: Confidentiality is recorded as the quality of being confidential.
items.cn: confidentiality 被记录下来，指「作为机密之事的性质」。

items.en: Modern legal and medical practice turns the quality into a professional duty.
items.cn: 现代法律与医疗实践把这种性质转变为一种职业义务。

note.en: Confidentiality belongs to the trust family around confide and confidential, and stands near words for secrecy and privacy.
note.cn: confidentiality 属于以 confide、confidential 为核心的「信任」词族，并与表示秘密、隐私的词相邻。

entries.definition: kept secret and not to be shared
to tell someone a secret because you trust them
trust in a person or in oneself
the state of keeping something hidden
the state of being free from public attention
the act of not revealing information

normalIntro.en: Confidentiality rests on trust: con- means fully, fidere means to trust, and what is entrusted is kept from others.
normalIntro.cn: confidentiality 的底层是信任：con- 表示「完全」，fidere 表示「信任」，受托的信息不向他人泄露。

normal.en: Break the word into con-, fidere, and -ity: a state of being fully trusted with a secret.
normal.cn: 把词拆成 con-、fidere 与 -ity：被完全信任而知道秘密的状态。

normal.en: Confide is the verb: you confide in a person you trust.
normal.cn: confide 是动词：你向信任的人吐露心事。

normal.en: Confidential means kept in trust; confidentiality is the state or duty that follows.
normal.cn: confidential 意为受托保密的；confidentiality 则是由此而来的状态或义务。

normal.en: A confidentiality agreement is the everyday collocation for a written promise.
normal.cn: 「confidentiality agreement」是书面保密承诺的常用搭配。

normal.en: Compare secrecy: secrecy is the fact of hiding, while confidentiality is the professional or legal quality.
normal.cn: 对比 secrecy：secrecy 是隐藏事实，confidentiality 是职业或法律上的保密性质。

abstract.en: Picture a finger raised to the lips in a quiet office.
abstract.cn: 想象安静的办公室里，一根手指竖在唇边。

abstract.en: Picture a locked drawer that holds a client file.
abstract.cn: 想象一只上锁的抽屉，里面放着客户档案。

abstract.en: Picture a clerk sealing a folder and writing a strict rule on its cover.
abstract.cn: 想象一名职员封好文件夹，在封面上写下严格的规定。

examples.en: The hospital must maintain the confidentiality of every patient record.
examples.cn: 医院必须对每一份病历保密。

examples.en: A confidentiality clause in the contract protects the trade secrets.
examples.cn: 合同中的保密条款保护商业秘密。

examples.en: She promised absolute confidentiality before the interview began.
examples.cn: 采访开始前，她承诺绝对保密。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「康非登歇里梯」——把秘密「非」要外传，守住托付之事；只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 confidere（完全信任）= con-（共同、完全）+ fidere（信任）→ confidentia（信任）→ 英语 confidential（机密的）→ confidentiality（保密性；保密义务），核心义「受托而守密」。

sensesIntro.en: Confidentiality begins with the secrecy of information held in trust, grows into a legal duty, and then into a practice, a contractual promise, and the protection of private communication.
sensesIntro.cn: confidentiality 从受托信息的秘密状态开始，长成法律上的保密义务，再延伸为保密做法、合同承诺与通信秘密的保护。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand over the lips, the other shielding a file.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手护住嘴唇，另一只手护住文件。

branches.en: The quality of being secret is the starting point of the whole family.
branches.cn: 秘密状态是整个词义家族的起点。

branches.en: Trust hardens into a duty not to disclose what was entrusted.
branches.cn: 信任凝固成一项不披露受托信息的义务。

branches.en: A duty becomes a working practice with rules and controls.
branches.cn: 义务再变成配有规则与管控的保密做法。

branches.en: A practice is written into a clause, so the word names the promise itself.
branches.cn: 保密做法被写进条款，于是这个词也指那项承诺本身。

branches.en: Both secrecy and protected communication rest on keeping private words from others.
branches.cn: 秘密状态与受保护的通信都建立在不让他人得知私人言谈之上。

intro.en: Confidentiality is built from the Latin trust family: con-, fidere, fides, confidentia, and the English words confident, confidential, and confide.
intro.cn: confidentiality 由拉丁语「信任」词族构成：con-、fidere、fides、confidentia，以及英语 confident、confidential、confide。

latinIntro.en: Latin confidere means to trust completely, and confidentia means trust or confidence.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 confidere 意为完全信任，confidentia 意为信任或信心。

items.example: The prefix con- strengthens the sense of trust.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 con- 强化了信任的含义。

items.example: Fidere is the trust at the heart of the word.
items.exampleCN: fidere 是这个词核心处的「信任」。

items.example: Fides supplies the noun idea of faith.
items.exampleCN: fides 提供「信念」这一名词概念。

items.example: Confidentia is the abstract noun of trust.
items.exampleCN: confidentia 是表示信任的抽象名词。

items.meaning: sure of oneself or of a fact
items.example: Confident keeps the idea of trust in oneself.
items.exampleCN: confident 保留了对自己或事实的信心。

items.example: Confidence names the feeling of trust.
The suffix -ial builds confidential from confidence.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ial 把 confidence 构成 confidential。

items.example: Confidential adds the duty of secrecy.
items.exampleCN: confidential 加上了保密的义务。

items.meaningCN: 表示性质或状态的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ity turns confidential into confidentiality.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ity 把 confidential 变成 confidentiality。

items.meaning: the state or duty of secrecy
items.example: Confidentiality is the headword of this entry.
items.exampleCN: confidentiality 是本词条的目标词。
